item.title: Two-vehicle crash on C.R. 21 leads to injuries
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- On Sunday, Feb. 15, at approximately 11 a.m. a 2017 Honda Piolet was northbound on C.R. 21 at the intersection of C.R. 38 and ignored the traffic signal.

item.title: Michigan City Academy accepting applications for spring session
item.description: MICHIGAN CITY, Ind. -- Applications are now being accepted by the Michigan City Neighborhood Leadership Academy spring session to help foster active leaders and make an impact in the city neighborhood by neighborhood.

item.title: Benton Harbor High School hosts Black History roundtable and luncheon
item.description: BENTON HARBOR, Mich. -- Benton Harbor High School will host Our Story, Our Voice, a family and community Black History roundtable and luncheon on Thursday, Feb. 19.

item.title: Community gathers for Black History Skate and Market in South Bend
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The third annual Black History Skate and Market was held on Sunday at Howard Park.

item.title: One person found conscious under bridge in St. Joseph River
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- At approximately 3:50 p.m. on Sunay, the members of Osolo EMS were dispatched for a reported drowning in the St. Joseph River at the Six-Span Bridge on C.R. 17.

item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Gillespie Event Center held their 14th annual Sweethearts Ball Saturday night.

item.title: Irish dominates NC State 79-67 in ACC victory
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Fighting Irish had a complete performance in a 79-67 win over NC State on Sunday afternoon inside Purcell Pavilion.

item.title: Hall of Fame broadcaster Pat Hughes headlines South Bend Cubs Foundation fundraiser
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- A legendary voice of baseball made a stop in South Bend on Sunday night, this time not to call a game, but to give back.

item.title: St. Margaret’s House hosts 27th Winter Walk in downtown South Bend
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- More than 500 people filled the streets of downtown South Bend on Sunday afternoon for the 27th annual Winter Walk, a one-mile fundraiser supporting St. Margaret’s House and the women it serves.
